summary: BUY area S1 batch (22-17 Task 3, D-16 area-batch tier), presented together once the BUY slice audit, thresholds and cards were complete. Eight S1 entries, each a way money could be lost, stuck, overspent or exposed under a realistic condition: AUD-BUY-002 (RC-01, STRAND) a buy that landed or can still land can be left with no trades row, a row flipped to failed, or no exit and anti-rug monitoring, because one broad catch treats every error after submission as a clean zero-spend failure (src/bot.ts:1087-1191 V2 with the catch at :1177-1191, and :1379-1516 V3; card BUY-02); AUD-BUY-003 (RC-02, LOSS) when the price quote fails the snipe is still sent with amountOutMin = 0, so any slippage or sandwich is accepted (src/bot.ts:1048-1056 V2 and :1362-1377 V3; card OD-15); AUD-BUY-004 (RC-04, OVERSPEND) the already-sniped check runs once, many awaits before the row is written and never again inside the nonce lock, so two concurrent handlers for one token both buy (src/bot.ts:881-885 V2 and :1210-1214 V3; card BUY-03); AUD-BUY-005 (RC-05, STRAND) there is no unhandledRejection handler and many async calls are not awaited, so one escaped rejection exits the process and stops every exit monitor and anti-rug subscription (src/bot.ts:1542, :1583, :1644, :1669, :2360; card OD-6); AUD-BUY-006 (RC-09, EXPOSURE) the Telegram allowlist allows everyone unless BOTH the sender and channel lists are set, and sender OR channel is enough, so an unlisted source can trigger buys (src/telegramListener.ts:53-58, :77-83; card OD-16); AUD-BUY-008 (RC-20, OVERSPEND, candidate) on DEX WebSocket reconnect the replaced providers are not destroyed, one reconnect loop per DEX races on ctx.wsProvider, there is no backfill or heartbeat, and a dashboard restart stacks a second close handler that later doubles every event (src/bot.ts:1549-1576 V3 and :1590-1618 V2; card OD-11); AUD-BUY-010 (independent, OVERSPEND) cooldown, max open positions and total exposure are checked long before the snipe is recorded, so concurrent handlers for different tokens all pass and overspend the caps (src/bot.ts:909 V2 and :1248 V3; card BUY-03); AUD-BUY-011 (independent, EXPOSURE) the dashboard "stop chain" does not stop buying: HTTP-polling chains keep polling and buying, Telegram alpha drops still route to stopped chains, and "start" adds a second poller (src/api/routes/chains.ts:121-145; card BUY-04). Already escalated and not re-counted here: AUD-BUY-001 (S0, ESC-BUY-01) and AUD-BUY-025 (S1, rediscovery of RC-10, linked through ESC-PRE-02 resolved_items). The bot is OFF for all of v7.0, so none of these can cause a loss now. Nothing is changed in Phase 22 (NAC-13): each item is proven with a real-path test in Phase 23 and fixed in Phase 24. The operator was asked to acknowledge and say whether any item needs its own urgent decimal phase before Phase 24, or to stop the phase.
